{{Top|leg}}
'''Claret''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] had multiple casks of off-world claret stored in the cellars beneath [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], a group of his former employees smashed the casks open in a rush of relief and self-pity at no longer being under his employ.

[[Sullustan wine]] was a claret.
